scope: Five E022 disagreements plus same-image comparison cells; no full independent transcription.
method: Inspect unresampled native-pixel crops. Compare L foot, i dot, S/s relative height and I/l ascender height. Do not infer a character solely from transcription majority or downstream plaintext scores.
source_policy: Retain all historical source bytes and canonical transcription. Record a separate explicit observation overlay, including any unresolved alternatives.
controls: Same-image uppercase L, lowercase dotted i, upper/lower S and previously agreed vertical stems; agreement is contextual evidence, not ground truth.
null_model: Not applicable to deterministic source and glyph inspection; no significance or decryption claim.
image_processing: Pillow used only for analysis crops/contact sheets. No resampling, sharpening, threshold-based replacement or generated glyphs. Core audit code remains standard library.
